fighters.name: Arkhe
lore: Arkhe is a monk from Valkun's Reach, an isolated city built beneath a stable skyborne rift in a newly contacted world on the edge of the known galaxy.
He is a wanderer, making his way through the alliance systems.
He is known primarily as an elemental monk whose body and spirit have harmonized with the leylines near the Valkun Rift.

moves.name: Leyline Flow
moves.flavor: Arkhe's bond with the leylines quickens his step the further he roams.
moves.mechanics: For every 10 tiles Arkhe covers in movement, he gains Flighted (+2 speed) for 1 turn.

moves.name: Airburst
moves.flavor: Arkhe exhales sharply, launching a compressed bolt of air at his target.
moves.mechanics: Deal 30 Elemental damage to a single enemy at range 3. Knocks target back 1 tile.

moves.name: Windswept
moves.flavor: With a gesture, Arkhe and a trusted ally trade places on the wind.
moves.mechanics: Swap positions with a target ally within range 6.

moves.name: Eye of the Rift
moves.flavor: Arkhe reaches through the rift, plucking an enemy from where they stand and dropping them somewhere far less comfortable.
moves.mechanics: Deal 60 Elemental damage to a single enemy at range 4. Reposition the target to any tile within 3 tiles of their current location.

fighters.name: Avarice
lore: Avarice is a water-attuned cleric hailing from Del'Terah, a lush oceanic planet marked by vast fjords, sunken temples, and semi-submerged cities that was found during the second push era of alliance exploration.
She is a devout follower of the water goddess Myriel and serves as a traveling divine channeler.

moves.name: Martyr's Bloom
moves.mechanics: On death, a 2x3 tile zone centered on Avarice gains Vitalized for 10 turns. Allies who end their turn on a Vitalized tile receive 20 healing.

moves.name: Torrent
moves.mechanics: Deal 20 Elemental damage to a single enemy at range 5.

moves.name: Mend
moves.mechanics: Restore 50 HP to a single ally within range 4.

moves.name: Sacred Ground
moves.mechanics: Bless a 3x3 area within range 4 for 3 turns. Allies who end their turn on a Blessed tile receive 30 healing and gain Arise (30% crit rate) for 3 turns. Arise cannot stack.

fighters.name: Krakoa
lore: Krakoa is a Voidblade operative in the Constellian Navy's elite special forces division, originally born and trained in Silgar.

His combat instincts, while exceptional, were often flagged as dangerously aggressive. He was eventually recruited into the Constellian Navy's Voidblade program after catching the attention of a Vice Helm during a live simulation.

moves.name: Battle-Scarred
moves.mechanics: Gains 10% Corrupt resistance and 10% Force resistance for every 100 HP lost.

moves.name: Force Strike
moves.mechanics: Deal 35 Force damage to a single enemy at range 3.

moves.name: Gale Charge
moves.mechanics: Deal 20 Elemental damage to all enemies in a size 3 cone originating at caster. Knocks all hit enemies back 3 tiles.

moves.name: Reel In
moves.mechanics: Deal 25 Elemental damage to a single enemy at range 5. Pulls the target 2 tiles toward Krakoa.

moves.name: Shockwave
moves.mechanics: Deal 40 Force damage to all enemies in a size 2 ring originating at caster. Knocks all hit enemies back 2 tiles.

fighters.name: Sanguine
lore: Sanguine is a Silgarian combat specialist known for her mastery of bleed-based damage.

She operates as a sanctioned solo agent under direct orders from high command. She is deployed when the Silgarians want a message sent along with the kill. When fear, suffering, and spectacle are as important as the target's elimination, Sanguine is the one for the job.

moves.name: Hemorrhage
moves.mechanics: When Sanguine applies a DoT, there is a 15% chance for that DoT to be applied again to the same target.

moves.name: Whipcrack
moves.mechanics: Deal 25 Force damage to a single enemy at range 3. 10% chance to apply Cut (10 Corrupt damage per turn) for 1 turn.

moves.name: Wire Sweep
moves.mechanics: Deal 30 Corrupt damage to all enemies in a size 1 cross originating at caster. Apply Bleed (15 Corrupt damage per turn) for 2 turns.

moves.name: Exsanguinate
moves.mechanics: Deal 60 Corrupt damage to a single enemy at range 3. All active DoT stacks on the target trigger immediately on hit without advancing their counters.

fighters.name: Rellin
lore: Rellin is a Line Master in the Constellian Navy, hailing from the mineral-dense world of Virellion.
He leads boarding operations on compromised vessels, specializing in shock entry and power system disruption.

moves.name: Deadeye
moves.mechanics: For every 10% accuracy Rellin has over 100%, he gains one stack of Sniper Focus (10% damage multiplier) for 1 turn.

moves.name: Precision Round
moves.mechanics: Deal 25 Elemental damage to a single enemy at range 7.

moves.name: Unsettling Shot
moves.mechanics: Deal 35 Elemental damage to a single enemy at range 8. Apply Unsettled (-10% accuracy) for 2 turns.

moves.name: Ready, Aim...
moves.mechanics: Apply Steady (+35% accuracy) to Rellin for 2 turns.

moves.name: Lethal Round
moves.mechanics: Deal 100 Elemental damage to a single enemy at range 8.

fighters.name: Captain Dinso
lore: Dinso is a decorated officer of the Constellian Army, best known as the commanding captain of the 73rd Constellian Company.

Born in Silgar, trained at StarSprawler Academy, and transferred into the Constellian forces, he rose through the ranks not just through tactical success but for his unwavering reputation as a protector and battlefield leader.

moves.name: Rally
moves.mechanics: At the start of Dinso's turn, all allies within 4 tiles gain Inspired (20% damage multiplier) for 1 turn.

moves.name: Vanguard Strike
moves.mechanics: Deal 25 Force damage to a single enemy at range 3.

moves.name: Shield Bash
moves.mechanics: Deal damage to all enemies in a size 3 cone originating at caster. Knocks all hit enemies back 3 tiles.

moves.name: Vanguard Assault
moves.mechanics: Dinso charges to a target tile within range 4. On arrival, deal Force damage to all enemies in a size 1 cross centered on the destination, knocking them back 2 tiles. Gain a 40-point shield on cast.

fighters.name: Jack
lore: Jack is a rogue artificer and saboteur hailing from Cindralith, known for his deep understanding of arcano-technological systems and a long history of weaponized mischief.
He often appears in CAF databases as a person of interest linked to unsanctioned weapons theft, sabotage, or data extraction.

moves.name: Reactive Dodge
moves.mechanics: When Jack takes damage, his dodge chance increases by 6%, up to a maximum of 24%.

moves.name: EMP Round
moves.mechanics: Deal 20 Corrupt damage to a single enemy at range 4.

moves.name: Neural Net
moves.mechanics: Deal 20 Corrupt damage to all enemies in a 2x2 box at range 3. Apply Rooted (speed reduced to 0) for 1 turn.

moves.name: Signal Jam
moves.mechanics: Apply Signal Jam (-35% accuracy) to a single enemy at range 4 for 2 turns.

moves.name: Hard Reset
moves.mechanics: Deal 30 Corrupt damage to a single enemy at range 5. Drain 30% of their Signature charge and add 2 turns to their skill cooldowns.

fighters.name: Vas Drel
lore: Vas Drel is a rune systems theorist within the IWO's Theoretical Division, known for his obsessive field research into arcane ward systems and pre-Breakpoint sigil architecture.
He carries several experimental wards designed to enhance allies' reflexes, accuracy, and healing responses.

moves.name: Ward Resonance
moves.mechanics: At the start of Vas Drel's turn, if he is within 2 tiles of an ally, there is a 30% chance to grant Boost (45% critical damage bonus) to a random adjacent ally.

moves.name: Arcane Bolt
moves.mechanics: Deal 15 Arcane damage to a single enemy at range 5.

moves.name: Rune Field
moves.mechanics: Place Inspiration tiles on a size 1 cross centered at range 2 for 2 turns. Allies who end their turn on an Inspiration tile gain Inspired (20% damage multiplier) for 1 turn.

moves.name: Runic Surge
moves.mechanics: Target a single ally within range 3. Each of the following has a 50% chance to be applied for 2 turns: Boost (45% critical damage bonus), LockedIn (25% critical rate), Recover (20 HP healed per turn), Sight (20% accuracy bonus).

fighters.name: Bessil
lore: Bessil is a Tier 1 Apex Class rift entity that is a living nightmare. There are few accounts of its existence, due to how effective it is at killing its targets.
It acts from a distance and confuses and traps its enemies, driving them mad with fear.

moves.name: Nightmare's Grasp
moves.mechanics: Bessil gains Tainted (50% corrupt resistance) for 5 turns. He is immune to the Stun and Rooted conditions.

moves.name: Psionic Lash
moves.mechanics: Deals 40 Corrupt damage to enemies in a cross size 1 at range 6.

moves.name: DarkShadow
moves.mechanics: Places a ring of DarkShadow tiles at range 4 (shapesize 4). Any enemy who walks into a DarkShadow tile takes 20 Corrupt damage, increased by 10 for every debuff currently on them.

moves.name: Terrorstrike
moves.mechanics: Deals 80 Corrupt damage to a single enemy at range 20.

fighters.name: Faru
lore: Faru is a Rifthunter from Thalnys. Rifthunters are genetically altered warriors trained from youth to combat rift-corrupted threats.
Faru is unaffiliated with any galactic faction and operates as a freelance hunter, fighting with an energy sword.

moves.name: Rifthunter's Focus
moves.mechanics: Faru gains a stacking Focused buff each time he receives a buff from any source, max 3 stacks. Each stack increases his damage by 15%.

moves.name: Sword Strike
moves.mechanics: Deals 40 Force damage to a single enemy at range 1. Consumes all Focused stacks — each stack consumed adds 15 flat damage to this strike.

moves.name: Sharpen Blade
moves.mechanics: Faru grants himself Sharpened for 2 turns — increases crit rate by 25%. If Faru already has any buffs active, also grants Evasive — increases dodge chance by 15%.

moves.name: All Out
moves.mechanics: Deals 80 Force damage to a single enemy at range 1. Damage increased by 10 for each buff currently active on Faru.

fighters.name: K.A.S.
lore: KAS (Kinematic Assault System) is a hyper-agile mechanized combat unit developed by a private military tech group in Cindralith under the banner of Halion Dynamics.
Designed to serve as a single-unit strike operative, KAS combines state-of-the-art technomantic circuitry with physical design principles derived from Rift-class creature countermeasures.

moves.name: Overdrive Matrix
moves.mechanics: Every time K.A.S. uses its Signature, its crit damage increases by 30%.

moves.name: Cinder Stream
moves.mechanics: Deals 30 Arcane damage to a single enemy at range 2.

moves.name: Dual Wield Precision
moves.mechanics: Deals 40 Arcane damage to enemies in a line size 4 at range 1.

moves.name: Sword Skill: Eclipse
moves.mechanics: Deals 100 Arcane damage to a single enemy at range 3 and applies Narcana (-20% arcane resistance) for 3 turns.

fighters.name: Olthar
lore: Olthar is the Lawbearer of Silgar and the highest judicial authority on the planet.

Constructed by the IWO to counter a corrupt Silgarian High Command, Olthar rose to power and is widely credited with ending Silgar's most shameful period and establishing the modern legal and ethical framework under which the city now operates.

moves.name: Judicial Resolve
moves.mechanics: Once per game, when an ally dies, Olthar resets both skill cooldowns and gains Inscribed (30% arcane resistance) and Tempered (30% elemental resistance) for 4 turns.

moves.name: Ocular Blaster
moves.mechanics: Deals 35 Arcane damage to a single enemy at range 2.

moves.name: Word of Slowing
moves.mechanics: Deals 30 Arcane damage to a single enemy at range 2 and applies Slowed (-2 speed) for 2 turns.

moves.name: JudgeWard
moves.mechanics: Applies JudgeWard to an ally at range 2 for 2 turns. When an ally with JudgeWard takes damage, half of that damage is redirected to Olthar.

moves.name: Uprooted Ground
moves.mechanics: A 3x3 box of tiles centered on Olthar is affected by Uprooted (-3 speed) for 3 turns. Only affects enemies.

fighters.name: Rei
lore: Rei is a mid-ranking operative within the Applied Arcana Division of the Intergalactic Wizarding Organization (IWO), holding the formal clearance rank of Tier IV ArcWarden.
She is based on Arkhalion, where she oversees the testing and deployment of experimental magical technologies near active or unstable rift zones. She is an offensive spellcaster.

moves.name: Dark Empress
moves.mechanics: Rei is immune to Arcane damage if it is 30 damage or less.

moves.name: Magician's Thrust
moves.mechanics: Deals 40 Arcane damage to enemies in a line size 2 at range 2.

moves.name: Burst Charge
moves.mechanics: Deals 25 Arcane damage to enemies in a cone size 3 at range 2 and has a 100% chance to apply Hex (15 Arcane DoT) for 3 turns.

moves.name: Stunlock Spear
moves.mechanics: Deals 70 Arcane damage to enemies in a line size 5 at range 3 and has a 60% chance to apply Stun for 1 turn.

fighters.name: Sedra
lore: A powerful child born to two high ranking parents in Aetherion. She is blessed by the goddess Nou, and has shown potential for great power.
She is a rising defender of Aetherion and often serves as a first response combatant for major rift activity in the region.

moves.name: Aetherian Momentum
moves.mechanics: Sedra is able to move after attacking, and terrain movement cost is halved for her.

moves.name: Momentum Punch
moves.mechanics: Deals 40 Arcane damage to a single enemy at range 2.

moves.name: Nova Lash
moves.mechanics: Sedra dashes to a target tile within range 4 and strikes in a cross size 1 on arrival, dealing 30 Arcane damage.

moves.name: Starburst Explosion
moves.mechanics: Deals 80 Arcane damage to enemies in a ring size 3 originating at Sedra.

fighters.name: Breach Specialist
lore: Silgarian spec ops unit whose goal is to contain small scale rift breaks.
Small scale rift breaks produce low level rift creatures, but lots of them, so they specialize in damage spread over a large distance.

moves.name: Suppressive Fire
moves.mechanics: Every 5 hits on enemy targets, gain a stack of Focused (15% damage multiplier).

moves.name: Firestarter
moves.mechanics: Deals 15 Elemental damage to enemies in a 2x1 box, range 3.

moves.name: Flamethrower
moves.mechanics: Deals 20 Elemental damage to enemies in a cone size 5, originating at Breach Specialist.

moves.name: Incendiary Payload
moves.mechanics: A 3x3 box aimed at the ground, range 3. Enemies within immediately take 30 Elemental damage. Affected tiles gain Scorched for 2 turns — walking through or ending a turn on a Scorched tile deals 20 Elemental damage.

fighters.name: Mizca
lore: Mizca are high-tier riftborn entities most commonly associated with Class B riftbreaks, though many A-class incidents have reported them as forward units.
Standing taller than a giraffe at full extension but built with a broad, humanoid physique, Mizca embody both raw power and battlefield disruption.

moves.name: Bloodlust
moves.mechanics: Gains a stack of Rage every time Mizca lands a crit. Consumed by Piledriver.

moves.name: Saber Slice
moves.mechanics: Deals 36 Corrupt damage to a single enemy, range 5.

moves.name: Sweep the Scythe
moves.mechanics: Deals 28 Corrupt damage to enemies in a ring size 3, originating at Mizca.

moves.name: Boulder Toss
moves.mechanics: Deals 50 Corrupt damage to enemies in a 3x2 box, range 4.

moves.name: Piledriver
moves.mechanics: Deals 70 Corrupt damage to enemies in a line size 3, range 3. Consumes all Rage stacks — each stack consumed adds 15 flat damage.

fighters.name: Skirvex
lore: The Skirvex is a quadrupedal riftbeast commonly encountered in Class B riftbreaks.

Heavily mutated, it functions as a mobile hive for parasitic riftflies that gestate within its rotting internal cavities. Its slow, unstable gait conceals its real threat: on death, the internal swarm is released, aggressively targeting nearby lifeforms.

moves.name: Parasitic Birth
moves.mechanics: Upon death, explodes in a 3x3 box, dealing 25 Corrupt damage to enemies within.

moves.name: Diseased Claws
moves.mechanics: Deals 15 Corrupt damage to a single enemy, range 2.

moves.name: Karrow Swarm
moves.mechanics: Applies a size 2 cross of Karrow to tiles for 3 turns, originating at Skirvex. Any enemy that is not a Riftbeast takes 10 Corrupt damage if they end their turn on a Karrow tile.

moves.name: Necrotic Bloom
moves.mechanics: Applies a 3x3 caster-origin box of Karrow to tiles. Enemies within the tiles immediately take 30 Corrupt damage upon cast.

fighters.name: Trustless Engineer
lore: A rogue inventor operating in the outer sectors of Cindralith, this engineer has no formal affiliations and no official permits.
Known only by outdated registry numbers and salvaged ID tags, he drifts from world to world selling volatile gadgets, offering quick repairs, or trading custom throwables for strange parts.

moves.name: Scrap Ingenuity
moves.mechanics: At the start of the turn, 30% chance to decrease skill cooldowns by 2, and independently a 25% chance to gain 20% sig charge.

moves.name: Makeshift Blaster
moves.mechanics: Deals 20 Corrupt damage to a single enemy, range 5.

moves.name: Grenade Toss
moves.mechanics: Marks a cross of size 3 tiles with Rigged, range 3. When an enemy moves onto a Rigged tile, it detonates for 25 Corrupt damage.

moves.name: Trappings
moves.mechanics: Marks a ring of size 3 tiles with Trappings, originating at Trustless Engineer. Enemies in affected tiles immediately take 30 Corrupt damage. Enemies who move onto a Trappings tile have a 50% chance to trigger Rooted (speed 0) and a 50% chance to lose a random buff.

fighters.name: Ulmika
lore: Ulmika is a Tier II Field Agent assigned to the Reconnaissance Subfield of the IWO Combat Division.

She operates as part of forward-deployed detachments, often assigned to accompany Constellian military units during Class C-D riftbreaks. Her role blends recon, magical analysis, and long-range elemental support.

moves.name: IWO's Patronage
moves.mechanics: At the start of her turn, if an ally is within 2 tiles (including Ulmika herself), removes a random debuff from them. Priority is given to allies over Ulmika.

moves.name: Wind Gust
moves.mechanics: Deals 13 Arcane damage to a single enemy, range 2.

moves.name: Arcane Blessing
moves.mechanics: Grants up to 2 allies 25 shield points each, range 2.

moves.name: Warding Ritual
moves.mechanics: A 3x3 box applied to tiles, originating at Ulmika. Tiles gain Supplied for 1 turn — allies who end their turn on a Supplied tile gain 20 shield.

fighters.name: Vemk Parlas
lore: Vemk, a Tier 5 Veilkeeper in the Intergalactic Wizarding Organization, is one of the IWO's most influential non-combat operatives.

Officially a diplomatic liaison, Vemk operates as a silent enforcer of the IWO's deeper agenda — ensuring that secrets stay buried, narratives remain controlled, and the organization's image never falters.

moves.name: Sabotaged Advantage
moves.mechanics: Every buff Vemk strips from an enemy has a 50% chance to grant him 15 shield points.

moves.name: Corrupted Barb
moves.mechanics: Deals 15 Corrupt damage to enemies in a ring size 2, range 3.

moves.name: Sabotage Play
moves.mechanics: Applies Sabotaged (-30% crit rate) to up to 2 enemies for 2 turns and removes a random buff from each, range 5.

moves.name: Vengeful Reversal
moves.mechanics: Removes all buffs from a targeted enemy and transfers them to a friendly ally of your choice, both within range 5.

fighters.name: Constellian Trooper
lore: A standard trooper in the Constellian Army. The Constellian Alliance is made of multiple star systems.
Troopers are trained and professional soldiers, forming the backbone of Constellian military operations.

moves.name: Overloaded
moves.mechanics: For every 75 damage dealt, gain a permanent 0.2x damage multiplier.

moves.name: Standard Issue Rifle
moves.mechanics: Deals 20 Force damage to a single enemy, range 3.

moves.name: Marksman Shot
moves.mechanics: Deals 35 Force damage to a single enemy, range 5.

moves.name: Carbine Overloaded
moves.mechanics: Deals 25 Force damage to enemies in a cone size 5, range 2.

fighters.name: Huron
lore: A fighter of legend, rumored to be of divine origin, born shortly after the Divine Rift Wars 300 years ago — though he seems to be only 20 or so in maturity.
He has performed many incredible feats of strength and speed, along with an ability to tap into innate divine power.

moves.name: Divine Vigor
moves.mechanics: Gains 10% crit damage for every 100 HP lost.

moves.name: Fistfall
moves.mechanics: Deals 50 Force damage to a single enemy, range 2.

moves.name: Solar Spray
moves.mechanics: Deals 25 Arcane damage to enemies in a cross size 2, originating at Huron. 80% chance to apply Covered (-20% accuracy) for 2 turns.

moves.name: Super Huron Fist
moves.mechanics: Deals 150 Arcane damage to a single enemy, range 1.

fighters.name: Legionary
lore: A veteran troop unit in the Silgar Military. Silgar is one of the three planets in the Arkhalion System, along with Aetherion and Cindralith, and boasts the greatest military of the three.
Legionaries are troops used to war, fighting as needed to win.

moves.name: Battle-Hardened
moves.mechanics: Legionary's attacks have an independent 25% chance to apply Winded (-15% Force resistance) for 2 turns on hit.

moves.name: Gladius Strike
moves.mechanics: Deals 25 Force damage to a single enemy, range 3. 25% chance to apply Winded (-15% Force res) for 2 turns.

moves.name: Rupturing Blow
moves.mechanics: Deals 30 Force damage to a single enemy. 50% chance to apply Rupture (20 Force DoT) for 2 turns. 25% chance to apply Winded (-15% Force res) for 2 turns.

moves.name: Hold The Line
moves.mechanics: A line size 4 originating at Legionary. Enemies hit take 50 Force damage and gain Shattered (-30% Force res) for 2 turns; each hit also has a 25% chance to apply Winded. Allies in the line gain a 30 point shield.

fighters.name: Nou
lore: A goddess-like entity of storm and sky, whose blessing empowers those she favors.
Nou is said to have once cleared a rift outbreak from a remote Aetherion outpost single-handedly, before other forces could even arrive.

moves.name: Sky Goddess
moves.mechanics: Nou starts with 20% dodge.

moves.name: Gale Cross
moves.mechanics: Deals 30 Elemental damage to enemies in a cross size 1, range 3.

moves.name: Blinding Gust
moves.mechanics: Deals 40 Elemental damage to a single enemy and inflicts Blinded (-50% accuracy) for 1 turn, range 3.

moves.name: WorldWinds
moves.mechanics: A 4x4 box on the ground, range 2. Enemies within immediately take 40 Elemental damage, and the tiles gain Stormy — enemies of Nou within a Stormy tile have 20% less accuracy.

fighters.name: Rover
lore: A modified version of the assistant droid most single-fighter troops in the Constellian Navy are issued.
Rover accompanies its operator into combat, providing targeting assistance and field support.

moves.name: Targeting System
moves.mechanics: At the start of Rover's turn, any allies within 2 tiles gain Sight (20% accuracy).

moves.name: Stun Bolt
moves.mechanics: Deals 10 Force damage to a single enemy, range 2.

moves.name: Radar
moves.mechanics: A cone size 5, originating at Rover. Enemies within gain Spotted (-30% dodge) for 3 turns and Compromised (-3 speed).

moves.name: Resupply
moves.mechanics: Choose an ally within range 3 to gain Recover (20 HoT) for 2 turns.

moves.name: Field Support
moves.mechanics: A cone size 3, originating at Rover. Allies within gain 50% sig charge, Energized (+2 speed) and Charged (30% damage multiplier) for 2 turns.

fighters.name: Raish
lore: Raish are corrupted quadrupedal riftbeasts commonly encountered in low-level riftbreaks. They are mutated beasts from Arkhalion Prime.
While not too aggressive on their own, they are dangerous in a pack.

moves.name: Pack Tactics
moves.mechanics: At the start of its turn, if Raish is within 2 tiles of an ally, it gains Howl for 1 turn. Howl increases damage multiplier by 15%.

moves.name: Claw Swipe
moves.mechanics: Deals 25 Corrupt damage to a single enemy, range 3.

moves.name: Feral Lunge
moves.mechanics: Deals 35 Corrupt damage to a single enemy, range 2. If Raish has Howl active, also applies Bleed (15 Corrupt DoT) for 2 turns.

moves.name: Pack Call
moves.mechanics: All allies within 3 tiles gain Hunter (15% crit rate) immediately, regardless of turn order. Raish deals 50 Corrupt damage in a cross size 1, originating at Raish.

fighters.name: Temple Guard
lore: A dedicated protector sworn to defend their order's sacred grounds and allies.
Temple Guards are trained to shield those around them, turning defense into a weapon of its own.

moves.name: Salvation
moves.mechanics: All allies start the match with a 20 point shield.

moves.name: Mace Strike
moves.mechanics: Deals 15 Elemental damage to a single enemy, range 2.

moves.name: Warding Halo
moves.mechanics: Applies Halo (20% Arcane and Corrupt resistance) for 2 turns to a single ally, range 2. 40% chance to also apply Clarity (15% accuracy) for 1 turn.

moves.name: Bulwark
moves.mechanics: Applies a 20 point shield to allies in a ring size 2, originating at Temple Guard.

moves.name: Sanctuary
moves.mechanics: Applies Sanctuary to tiles in a 2x3 box for 2 turns, range 2. Allies who end their turn on a Sanctuary tile gain 20 shield, 30 healing, and Empowered (20% damage multiplier).

fighters.name: Trex
lore: A massive riftborn predator, feared for its raw power and relentless aggression.
T-Rex becomes exponentially more dangerous when isolated — cornered prey fights hardest.

moves.name: Apex Predator
moves.mechanics: When T-Rex is the only surviving member of his team, gain a permanent 50% damage multiplier and fill his signature charge. Once per game.

moves.name: Bite
moves.mechanics: Deals 35 Corrupt damage to a single enemy, range 2.

moves.name: Thick Hide
moves.mechanics: Shields self for 30 points and gains Regenerative Hide (15 HoT) for 2 turns.

moves.name: Venomous Maw
moves.mechanics: Deals 50 Corrupt damage to a single enemy and applies Poisoned (20 Corrupt DoT) for 2 turns, range 3.

fighters.name: Virae
lore: A frost-attuned support fighter who shields those around her from harm.
Virae's calm, measured presence on the battlefield belies the protective power she wields.

moves.name: Frost Ward
moves.mechanics: At the start of her turn, Virae and any ally within 1 tile gain a 10 point shield.

moves.name: Frost Bolt
moves.mechanics: Deals 12 Elemental damage to a single enemy, range 4.

moves.name: Preservation
moves.mechanics: Selects a single ally within range 2. Extends all of their active buffs by 1 turn and applies Glacial Bloom (20% Elemental resistance) for 2 turns.

moves.name: Glacial Bastion
moves.mechanics: Gives all allies within a 2x2 box a 45 point shield, range 2.

fighters.name: VyGar
lore: A hulking Cindralith Trust prototype, built to absorb punishment and dish it back out.
VyGar is at his most dangerous when left unchallenged — a lull in the fighting only sharpens his focus.

moves.name: Patient Predator
moves.mechanics: After his first round, if VyGar has not taken damage since his last turn, he gains Hunter (15% crit rate) for 2 turns.

moves.name: Heavy Slam
moves.mechanics: Deals 35 Force damage to a single enemy, range 3. Knockback 1.

moves.name: Decay Touch
moves.mechanics: Deals 40 Corrupt damage to a single enemy, range 1. Applies Decaying (-20% damage multiplier) for 2 turns.

moves.name: Prototype Beam
moves.mechanics: An experimental Cindralith Trust prototype. Deals 25 Arcane damage to enemies in a line size 3, range 2.

moves.name: Overload Cross
moves.mechanics: Deals 60 Force damage in a cross size 1 at caster origin, applies Shocked (-15% Elemental resistance) for 2 turns to all hit enemies.
